summary: Owner request (2026-11-05, #1010): source and defend the two open bridges of WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE. Pinned and read: Dei Filius ch. 4 and canons IV (Latin, vatican.va), CIC 1983 cann. 747-755 and 1364-1369 (Latin, vatican.va; Book VI as revised 2021), Summa contra Gentiles I.2 n.2-I.3 n.2 (Corpus Thomisticum), PU §373 (pinned German), SEP Fideism §3. (a) is supported by the practice's law of teaching (can. 749 §2), membership (cann. 750-751, 1364-1365), its self-description (Dei Filius ch. 4, can. IV.3 on the declared sense of dogma) and Wittgenstein's 'Theologie als Grammatik'; (b) by Dei Filius ch. 4 (two orders distinct in principle; God known by the gentiles) and SCG I.2-3 (natural reason to which all must assent, against pagans; the philosophers' proofs). The fideist replies are recorded at full strength as unattributed alternatives (conciliar teaching is theology, not grammar; natural reason within a theological horizon), with the supports they have (Phillips 2005, 75; Clayton and Taylor) and the texts against them as attacks. Rejected: recording either bridge as stated (no text states it; each source leaves a named gap) or the attacks as refutations (their premises are stated, not established). Logic-first follow-up for the Moorean candidate batch (#1119, 2026-11-06): the grammar-case vocabulary now exists (FIDEISM-GRAMMAR-CASES-PARTITION), so its absence is no longer the blocker. The exact original Challenge still has three unestablished inputs, including the stated CouncilDefinesNaturalKnowabilityReading, not only these two bridges. FideismFailsAsDescription is the negation of InternalGrammarReading ∧ CutOffReading; the recorded alternative to revelation is CutOffReading alone. No refutes relation targets that single rival. In-memory frontier settlement probes at main 0367eebc establish the bundle-failure result if all three inputs are hypothetically settled, but do not refute CutOffReading or lower any route. See docs/notes/moorean-floor-candidates.md for the ranked candidate batch, precise scopes and remaining registration/interpretation gaps. Conciliar theology/grammar definition audit (2026-11-06): the old untyped theology-not-grammar alternative to the normative definition bridge is now scoped to the exact bridge negation. Raw reply/source claims remain unchanged. New typed siblings distinguish theological content, practical religious-life role, actual own-standard endorsement and a substantive theology-excluded-from-own-standards premise. Descriptive content alone permits the old normative bridge; it neither identifies nor refutes the strong exclusion reading. Content+explicit exclusion+an actual Defined witness composes into the exact bridge negation. Shared own-status, never-own status and actual mixed defined witnesses form a checked EM fork; named uniform coverage stays open. Four controls preserve a positive religious-life endorsed move, witness descriptive theology with the bridge true, explicit exclusion with actual bridge failure and the old fideist pair, mixed status, and empty-definition universal overlap. The older needsDefinitionIsOwnStandard theorem shows a missing bridge, not identity of a descriptive theology thesis with its negation. The new two-move exclusion control keeps ordinary endorsement nonempty rather than repeating its all-OwnStandard-false fixture. The old bridge paraphrase now states only normative endorsement and leaves theological/practical roles separate; its Lean type and source claims are unchanged. Council-defined natural knowability supplies a weak actual Defined witness; original cut-off arguments still need both Defined and natural content, and retain explicit strong-version reasons. No author attribution, actual institutional/liturgical fact, philosophical floor or root premise is established. Natural-reason definition audit (2026-11-06): a typed modest descriptive-horizon sibling now separates theistic users/internal endorsement from absence of shared standards. Controls witness actual nonmember use within a theistic audience under shared, nonshared and mixed standard profiles. Nonmembership in one practice is not neutrality to every worldview. The original shared bridge is reused; all-nonshared and mixed positive/negative witness propositions are separate. EM checks shared/nonshared/mixed structural coverage; named uniform coverage stays open. The old horizon alternative now has the exact negation of the shared bridge as endpoint, derived only from all-nonshared plus an actual natural-knowability move, or by composing the mixed-profile rejection. The original prose horizon reconstruction and all source/support claims are unchanged. The existing shared statement paraphrase no longer implies internal endorsement is excluded: its Lean type never prohibited OwnStandard alongside shared standards. The defined conciliar move supplies a weaker actual natural-move witness; the two old grammar arguments still need Defined and record why. Rejected: theistic audience implies nonshared standards; non-Christian knowers stand outside every theological horizon; shared reasoning forbids own-standard endorsement; mixed witnesses refute a whole worldview; or a vacuous universal profile proves an actual natural move. Source warrant remains blocked; the conditional logical follow-up succeeds without deciding those source/applicability questions. Religious-language endpoint audit (2026-11-06): preserved the unbound later-Phillips internality and face-value source statements; their broad automatic alternative edge is now a guarded attack. New analyst local content/belief/fact/truth and matched cross-discourse profiles show internal truth variation is not automatically nonreference or nondescriptiveness. An actual religious non-descriptive witness rejects local descriptive status; a same-content religious truth-difference witness rejects only the stronger uniform profile. Unrelated-sentence variation does not supply that witness. Checked structural local-uniform/local-difference/local-failure coverage and explicit open local-menu coverage preserve the further relevant option. Three profile controls and an independent non-description model retain both serious criticisms without inventing source identities. Source-fidelity of minimalist descriptive-role denial and applicability of the analyst profiles remain open. Review correction (P1, #1159): the coarse ReligiousSemanticModels third conjunct exports only local failure, not which clause fails; its second also does not export that truth variation occurs on a nonreligious sentence or that the matched religious scope is inhabited. Narrowed those old descriptions without changing their frozen Challenge/type. A stronger DetailedReligiousSemanticModels target now exports actual matched religious content, explicitly nonreligious variation, an actual belief failure with the other local clauses retained, and an actual descriptive failure with the other clauses retained. Its Boolean sentence/content dictionary also exports truth agreement with the assigned fact criterion in each discourse, avoiding reliance on hidden witness properties or empty matched scopes.
blocker: The two interpretation bridges and the council premise remain unestablished. Grammar-case vocabulary is available, but the original theorem refutes a conjunction, whereas the recorded revelation rival is its CutOffReading conjunct alone. A counted single-rival refutation needs a checked specialization with an established InternalGrammar/profile premise, or a justified revision to the recorded rival bundle, and all its premises established. The relation's external-signs/shared-reason reading also remains untyped. Two bridge approvals alone do not close revelation; more sourcing is not on the critical path. The descriptive theology profile does not decide normative endorsement; its exclusion requires independent applicability/warrant. The raw mixed reply includes philosophical-distortion and grammar claims beyond this modest role profile; a stronger identity would need a typed content/fidelity criterion and explicit role/grammar mapping, not a descriptive label. Actual authority and source fidelity remain open; conditional role comparison does not require deciding them first.
